title: Grow the List
prompt: colors starts with red. Append blue, then insert green at the front, then print the list.

tests.name: prints mutated list
tests.code:
assert len(printed) == 1 and "green" in printed[0] and "red" in printed[0] and "blue" in printed[0], f"expected [green, red, blue], got {printed}"
assert printed[0].find("green") < printed[0].find("red") < printed[0].find("blue"), f"order must be green, red, blue, got {printed[0]}"
tests.hint: append adds at the end; insert(0, x) puts at the front.
